title: The conormal module of an ideal generated by a regular sequence is free
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $c\ge0$ and $f_1,\dots,f_c\in R$ a regular sequence in $R$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence], and let $J=(f_1,\dots,f_c)$. Then the $R/J$-module $J/J^2$ is free with basis the classes $f_1\bmod J^2,\dots,f_c\bmod J^2$; in particular $J/J^2\cong(R/J)^{\oplus c}$.
